features.name: Setting Up a Free Digital Business Card
features.purpose: Enables users to quickly create and customize an interactive digital business card with contact info, social links, custom themes, and typography.
features.intendedUser: Professionals, freelancers, creators, and business executives
features.customerProblemSolved: Traditional paper cards are static, easily lost, and outdated quickly. This provides an instant, interactive, mobile-optimized card.
features.startingConditions: Public access to https://www.reallysimpleapps.com; no upfront payment or account required to start creating.
demonstrationSteps: 1. Navigate to https://www.reallysimpleapps.com and click 'Start for Free' or 'Create Card'.
3. Enter synthetic professional details (Name: 'Sarah Jenkins', Title: 'Product Lead', Company: 'Apex Dynamics', Bio).
4. Configure contact channels (Mobile, Email, Website, LinkedIn).
5. Select dynamic color themes (e.g. Midnight, Aurora, Sunset) and watch real-time live preview update.
7. Click 'Review & Choose Plan' to view free card deployment options.
features.expectedOutcomes: Live card preview updates dynamically with every keystroke; professional layout rendered with interactive action buttons (Connect, Save, Wallet).
features.verificationEvidence: Screenshots captured at recordings/landing_preview.png and recordings/create_card_page.png; inspected interactive DOM elements and plan review buttons.
features.knownLimitations: Synthetic data used to avoid leaking user info. Final plan submission stops before any live payment/destructive action.
